modern_card.name: Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (LCYW-EN165, Legendary Collection 3: Yugi's World Mega Pack)

changes.historical_text: When a Beast-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can pay 1000 Life Points to Special Summon this card from your hand or the Graveyard.
changes.modern_text: If this card is in your hand or Graveyard when a face-up Beast-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can pay 1000 Life Points; Special Summon this card.
changes.summary: Functional erratum on two points. The era text triggers off "a Beast-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard" with no position requirement and no Damage Step exclusion; the errata'd text requires the destroyed Beast to have been face-up and adds "(except during the Damage Step)". So the era card can pay 1000 LP and Special Summon itself off a face-down Beast being destroyed, and can do so inside the Damage Step when a Beast is destroyed by battle - the exact window a period Beast deck uses. Both restrictions are baked into the modern implementation, whose trigger is EVENT_TO_GRAVE with a POS_FACEUP previous-position filter and no EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP property.

gap.reason: Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode
gap.behavioural_impact: In an Edison snapshot EDOPro refuses the Damage Step Green Baboon revival after a Beast is destroyed by battle, and refuses it entirely when the destroyed Beast was face-down, so a period Beast deck loses plays that its 2007-2010 text allows.

review.notes: The packet's single upstream entry, 511001661 "Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest (Manga)" in cards-unofficial.cdb, is a DIFFERENT card, not a historical version of 46668237: it triggers off Insect/Beast/Plant/Beast-Warrior monsters on either side of the field and its text matches the lineage at only ratio 0.7277. It cannot serve as a baseline implementation, so this card remains a genuine gap. Its script is still useful corroboration: the older-style trigger is scripted with EVENT_DESTROYED plus EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP+EFFECT_FLAG_DELAY, while the modern Green Baboon script (the '-' side of the diff) uses EVENT_TO_GRAVE with no damage-step property - the script-level counterpart of the errata's added "(except during the Damage Step)". Era text: v0 (JUMP-EN014, 2007-07-15) is in force for Edison (2010-04-24); the card postdates GOAT. Trailing cosmetic revision v1 -> v2 (SBCB-EN053, 2020-11-26: GY wording, "Beast monster", location clause moved) is not recorded as a change; cards.cdb matches v2 exactly. Green Baboon is not on the EdisonFormat.com Functional Errata list.
